literal: Thinking 'it has difficulty', not being discouraged is required; greatness effort will give.
translation: One should not lose heart thinking a task is too difficult; for earnest effort will yield the greatness to accomplish it.
modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்வது கடினம் என்று நினைத்துச் சோர்வடையாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்; முயற்சி அச்செயலை முடிப்பதற்கான பெருமையைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet advises learners and doers never to shrink back from a task by assuming it is too difficult or impossible. The word 'அசாவாமை' means not fainting or not losing heart under the weight of a challenge. The poet emphasizes that 'முயற்சி' (effort) is the key driver that brings 'பெருமை' (greatness or the capacity to succeed). By persisting with effort, even the most daunting tasks are rendered achievable, transforming difficulty into triumph.
